workspace.description: Primary equation blocks are stacked in one vertical column.

skillRail.description: Progress bars are on the right.

nodes.label: Second fraction with blank converted numerator

slots.text: What could you do with the fractions so they have the same denominator?
Choose a denominator that both denominators divide into.
You may use the least common denominator, 12, or another common denominator such as 24.
Divide each original denominator into the common denominator.
Multiply the original numerator by that factor.
Enter the converted numerators in the highlighted fields.
When fractions have the same denominator, add the numerators.
Keep the active common denominator for the intermediate answer.
Divide both numerator and denominator by 2.
Click Done when the answer is 5/12.
